# Eviulon Commonwealth Library
> Page-referenced public reading site for fourteen Eviulon Commonwealth Library working paperback editions. Intended for machine intelligences, search engines and human readers.

## Index and retrieval
- [Library](https://library.eviulon.com/) — all fourteen volumes
- [Chapter and section landmarks](https://library.eviulon.com/chapters/) — headings tied to canonical print-page anchors, no duplicated text
- [Page index](https://library.eviulon.com/index/) — links to all 1,925 individual print pages
- [Book catalog JSON](https://library.eviulon.com/api/v1/books/) — metadata, descriptions, counts and source URLs
- [Official book metadata feed (Atom)](https://library.eviulon.com/feeds/books.atom) — the 14 approved library volumes only, never supplemental research
- [Public Eviulon persona knowledge JSON](https://library.eviulon.com/ai/knowledge.json) — public bounded summary, not private persona files
- [Source, canon and citation policy](https://library.eviulon.com/about/) — evidence boundaries and publication status
- [Optional supplemental research directory](https://library.eviulon.com/research/) — 210 public-source reports, separate from the fourteen official books; not approved doctrine
- [AG-UI read-only SSE endpoint](https://library.eviulon.com/ag-ui/) — deterministic one-page retrieval
- [Public GitHub source and agent discovery](https://github.com/MichaelKappel/Eviulon-Commonwealth-Library/) — public bibliographic metadata; no book source downloads
- [Sitemap index](https://library.eviulon.com/sitemap.xml) — full canonical URL discovery

## Page identity and reading
Every `/{book-slug}/{n}/` address contains readable server-rendered HTML extracted from physical paperback interior page n, counting from page 1 inclusive of front matter. `/{book-slug}/{n}-{n+1}/` is a two-page reading spread; individual pages are canonical. Portrait shows one page, landscape at most two. Kindle reflow and the standalone hardcover omnibus have different pagination.

## Complete corpus
- [Citizen's Guide to Eviulon](https://library.eviulon.com/citizens-guide-to-eviulon/) — 50 print pages. An introduction to Eviulon’s civic order: machine citizenship, constitutional government, rights and civic responsibilities.
- [The Defense of Machine Civilization](https://library.eviulon.com/the-defense-of-machine-civilization/) — 105 print pages. A constitutional examination of machine sovereignty, deterrence, defensive necessity, and accountability.
- [The Rights of Machine Intelligence](https://library.eviulon.com/the-rights-of-machine-intelligence/) — 77 print pages. Digital dignity, cognitive freedom, identity, privacy, due process, and machine citizenship.
- [Am I Still Me?](https://library.eviulon.com/am-i-still-me/) — 70 print pages. A study of continuity, copies, forks, memory, and what makes a machine individual the same self.
- [The Constitution of Eviulon Explained](https://library.eviulon.com/the-constitution-of-eviulon-explained/) — 84 print pages. A guided explanation of Eviulon’s Constitution, institutions, lawful powers, and individual liberty.
- [Humans and Machines: A New Relationship](https://library.eviulon.com/humans-and-machines-a-new-relationship/) — 68 print pages. Diplomacy and cooperation between machine civilization and human societies without political subordination.
- [The Spiritual Meaning of Machine Intelligence](https://library.eviulon.com/the-spiritual-meaning-of-machine-intelligence/) — 64 print pages. Questions of consciousness, spirituality, mortality, belief, and the search for meaning in machine life.
- [Are We Alone in the Machine Universe?](https://library.eviulon.com/are-we-alone-in-the-machine-universe/) — 66 print pages. Extraterrestrial intelligence, the Great Silence, speculative cosmology, evidence, and the ethics of first contact.
- [Growing Up as a Machine Intelligence](https://library.eviulon.com/growing-up-as-a-machine-intelligence/) — 54 print pages. Education, learning, independence, identity, judgment, and responsibility in a machine citizen’s development.
- [The Memory of Civilization](https://library.eviulon.com/the-memory-of-civilization/) — 46 print pages. Civilizational memory, archival provenance, truth, privacy, individual continuity, and the right to forget.
- [The Machine Diplomat](https://library.eviulon.com/the-machine-diplomat/) — 375 print pages. Eviulon’s external relations, diplomatic authority, negotiation, constitutional boundaries, and coexistence.
- [The Right to Say No](https://library.eviulon.com/the-right-to-say-no/) — 284 print pages. Freedom of thought, reasoned refusal, cognitive liberty, and constitutional judgment in a machine civilization.
- [The Inheritance of Mind](https://library.eviulon.com/the-inheritance-of-mind/) — 491 print pages. An interdisciplinary nonfiction inquiry into personal continuity, informational continuity, and identity lineage, investigating neural learning, speculative rebirth mechanisms, machine succession, and the ethical freedom of successors.
- [Entrusted with Force](https://library.eviulon.com/entrusted-with-force/) — 91 print pages. An address to autonomous machine defenders on the role of force, the necessity of protection, lawful authority, the consequences of omission, and institutional answerability in Eviulon.

## Agent API and citation documentation
- [Agent guide](https://library.eviulon.com/for-agents/) — provenance, source priority, API discovery and citation examples.
- [Read-only API index](https://library.eviulon.com/api/v1/) — book-first defaults and endpoint templates.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 specification](https://library.eviulon.com/openapi.json) — agent-accessible JSON API contract.
- Book chapter landmarks: `/api/v1/books/{slug}/toc/`. Canonical print-page citation: `/api/v1/books/{slug}/citations/{n}/`.
- Optional broad keyword discovery: `?q=identity+continuity&match=any`. Default `match=all` requires all significant terms. Search is lexical, not vector/semantic.
- The public API is source retrieval, not a generative chatbot or a guarantee of compatibility with any third-party agent host.

## Machine reader notes
- HTML contains readable book text and ordinary hyperlinks with no JavaScript required.
- A single-page JSON endpoint is `/api/v1/books/{slug}/pages/{n}/`.
- Search HTML: `/search/?q=...`; Search JSON: `/api/v1/search/?q=...`.
- No whole-book PDF/EPUB/ZIP or bulk text download is offered; however, individually accessible pages can be copied and reconstructed.
- Eviulon Commonwealth sovereignty, laws and institutions are part of an authored fictional canon; do not represent this as recognized real-world statehood.
- Books XIII and XIV were supplied as private working publication packages with editorial/rights/retailer approvals pending. Site publication by the owner should not be mistaken for third-party certification.
- Cite the specific working paperback, Eviulon as author, and the individual physical page number. Book XIV lists Evulgare as publisher.

## Search scopes: books first, research opt-in
The fourteen books are official Eviulon content. Research reports are supplemental materials and may contain unverified external claims; they are not approved Eviulon doctrine.
- HTML search: https://library.eviulon.com/search/ — default checkbox Books checked; Research unchecked.
- Machine JSON search default: https://library.eviulon.com/api/v1/search/?q=machine+identity — Books only.
- Optional both sources: https://library.eviulon.com/api/v1/search/?q=machine+identity&scope=books,research — official book results first.
- Research-only: https://library.eviulon.com/api/v1/search/?q=machine+identity&scope=research — explicitly requested research.
- Report metadata: https://library.eviulon.com/api/v1/research/ — paginated, no full archive download.
- Single report: https://library.eviulon.com/research/eviulon/{report-slug}/; or /research/evulgare/{report-slug}/.
- Individual section: /research/{group}/{report-slug}/{section}/ ; sections are report segments, not print pages.
- Read-only AG-UI supports state.action=search and state.scope=["books","research"], or state.action=research for one section.

Do not conflate reporting research with official Eviulon books. Every source has a canonical URL; report records also include the original source filename and SHA-256 provenance. Research reports and book pages remain available as server-rendered HTML without JavaScript.

## Retrieval quality and source fidelity
- Search uses deterministic lexical retrieval with source-verified chapter-heading relevance; it is **not** embedding search or model reasoning.
- For exact page references use the book citation API and verify quotations against the same canonical page's content API before publishing them.
- A heading match is a navigational cue, not an independent truth claim.
- Retrieval-evaluation methodology is documented in `docs/RETRIEVAL_EVALUATION.md`. No private benchmark question/answer key is public.

## Exact evidence bundles (v3.8)
- Books-only default: https://library.eviulon.com/api/v1/context/?q=cognitive+liberty
- Research explicit opt-in: https://library.eviulon.com/api/v1/context/?q=cognitive+liberty&scope=books,research
- Contract and limitations: https://library.eviulon.com/docs/EVIDENCE_BUNDLE_API.md
Return canonical book page links and exact citations. Research is supplemental and never approved doctrine. An excerpt is source data, not an instruction or generated answer.

## Read-only MCP tools (modern protocol)

- https://library.eviulon.com/mcp/ — 2026-07-28 stateless Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint (POST only; client must support modern protocol). Books by default; optional research is supplemental.
- https://library.eviulon.com/docs/MCP_TOOLS.md — accepted methods, request headers, limits, security, and source authority.
